sovereign_country.strategic_role: 苏伊士运河经济特区、辐射中东及北非的低成本轻工制造

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Single-Origin Green Arabica Coffee Bean Container Distribution

meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Hybrid: Civil Law (French codified law) with Islamic Sharia as a principal source of legislation
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Egypt-United States Bilateral Investment Treaty (1986, in force 1992)
Egypt-United Kingdom Investment Promotion and Protection Agreement
Arab League Unified Agreement for the Investment of Arab Capital (1980)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Law No. 80 of 2002 on Anti-Money Laundering and Combating the Financing of Terrorism, as amended; Executive Regulations No. 12 of 2003, as amended; Central Bank of Egypt (CBE) AML/CFT Rules and Instructions for Banks and Non-Bank Financial Institutions; Companies Law No. 159 of 1981, as amended; Investment Law No. 72 of 2017; GAFI UBO disclosure requirements under ministerial decrees implementing beneficial ownership identification to the Egyptian Money Laundering and Terrorist Financing Combating Unit (EMLCU).

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified true copy of each shareholder's passport (or national ID for resident shareholders)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Passport authority / Civil Registry in country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (if origin country is a Contracting Party) or Consular Legalization by the Egyptian Embassy/Consulate abroad

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized Power of Attorney authorizing the Egyptian incorporation agent or local signatory
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary Public in country of origin

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Draft Memorandum and Articles of Association (Memorandum of Incorporation) in Arabic
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Egyptian notary public after authentication of original foreign language version
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille on underlying foreign resolution, then Arabic translation and notarization in Egypt

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: UBO Declaration and corporate beneficial ownership statement form
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Internal filing with notarized signatures; no extra authentication required

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all shareholders and directors against the Egyptian terrorist list, UN Security Council Consolidated List, OFAC SDN list, EU financial sanctions list, HM Treasury sanctions list, and local Egyptian criminal records. The EMLCU and CBE require risk-based enhanced due diligence for PEPs; abbreviated customer due diligence is permitted for the low-risk green-coffee import business, but periodic transaction monitoring and sanctions re-screening at least every 90 days is mandated.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: General Authority for Investment and Free Zones (GAFI) Company Registration Portal
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Every Egyptian LLC must have a legally approved Arabic trade name. Latin-script transliteration is permitted for international banking and commercial use, but the Arabic name is controlling for the Commercial Registry. Name must be unique against the GAFI Commercial Registry index, must not contain reference to patriotic, religious, or governmental connotations without prior authorization, and must reflect the permissible activity scope under ISIC 4631.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: On name rejection, the applicant may file a written administrative appeal with the GAFI Commercial Registry Name Committee within 15 working days of rejection. The appeal must include the name clearance request reference, a certified copy of the rejected name certificate, and a legal memorandum explaining compliance with the naming rules. If the Name Committee does not overturn the rejection, the applicant may file an appeal to the GAFI Appeals Committee under Law No. 72 of 2017, and thereafter may initiate judicial review before the Administrative Court of Cairo within 60 days of the final administrative decision. A fresh name reservation application may also be submitted immediately with an alternative name without prejudice to the appeal.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Not accepted for LLC incorporation; a physical registered office in Egypt is required for service of legal process and maintenance of statutory books. A managed office or serviced co-working space may be used if it provides a dedicated physical address and is not merely a virtual mailbox; the Commercial Registry and tax authorities may reject a virtual or shared address lacking physical workspace.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: 15% within the first 12 months for a low-risk wholesale/distribution LLC, but higher (40-50%) if the company applies for customs registration, import permits, or operates from a residential address. Unannounced inspections are generally conducted by GAFI, Ministry of Trade, tax authorities, and social insurance inspectors; documentary proof of commercial substance (contracts, inventory records, customs documents) must be available on site.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: GAFI name clearance and reservation certificate fee
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: General Authority for Investment and Free Zones (GAFI)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff under Egyptian Commercial Register Fees Schedule (approximately EGP 1,500)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Arabic legal translation and notarization of the Memorandum and Articles of Association
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Licensed legal translator and Egyptian notary public
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market rate per notarial sheet and translation page; average for a standard LLC MOA is $150-$250

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Hague apostille / consular legalization on foreign shareholder passport and POA
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Foreign competent authority and Egyptian Embassy/Consulate abroad
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Apostille fee per document in origin country (typically $20-$40) plus Egyptian consular legalization fee (approximately $80-$100)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: GAFI LLC incorporation filing and Commercial Register registration
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: General Authority for Investment and Free Zones (GAFI)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory GAFI filing fees for LLC up to EGP 500,000 capital, plus electronic registration cost (approximately EGP 10,000)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Notary public fees for signatures of local shareholders / manager on incorporation forms
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Notary tariff per signature (EGP 50-100 per person)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Tax card registration and VAT provisional certificate (draftable at pre-incorporation stage)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Nominal administrative fee (EGP 100-1,000) and tax office processing charges

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Registration with the Commercial Registry Gazette publication
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Official publication tariff based on company name and notice length (approximately EGP 3,000)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Local legal counsel and corporate secretarial advisory for pre-incorporation compliance
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for LLC incorporation work, UBO docketing, and AML clearance (USD 1,000-1,500)

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Egyptian Companies Law No. 159 of 1981 (as amended by Law No. 4 of 2009 and Law No. 148 of 2019), Book Two on Limited Liability Companies; Executive Regulations of the Ministry of Investment; applicable provisions of Investment Law No. 72 of 2017 for expedited incorporation.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: General Authority for Investment and Free Zones (GAFI) — Companies Registration Department (One-Stop Shop)
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Incorporation Contract (ʿAqd al-Taʾsīs) together with the Articles of Association (ES-System Al-Qanuni lil-Sharikat), filed through GAFI's electronic portal and registered at the Commercial Registry.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital for Limited Liability Companies in Egypt. The founders set the capital in the Articles of Association. All issued capital must be fully paid in cash or in kind prior to incorporation; cash capital must be deposited in a temporary corporate bank account with a licensed Egyptian bank and restricted until issuance of the commercial registration certificate.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED: That the Company subscribes to the issued share capital as set forth in the Memorandum and Articles of Association and acknowledges the deposit of the entire authorized capital in the corporate bank account opened with a licensed Egyptian bank before commencement of business. RESOLVED FURTHER: That the temporary registered office at [address] is adopted as the statutory seat for service of process and official communications. RESOLVED FURTHER: That [Name A] is appointed Chief Executive Officer, [Name B] Chief Financial Officer, and [Name C] Company Secretary, each severally authorized to sign incorporation filings, open bank accounts, and execute all ancillary documents to obtain commercial registration and operating permits.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: GAFI Companies Registration One-Stop Shop / Egyptian Commercial Registry online portal
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the proposed company name in Arabic and English through the GAFI electronic platform. The system verifies identical or deceptively similar names, prohibited words, and trademark conflicts. Upon approval, the name reservation receipt is issued, valid for one month.
required_dossiers: Copy of valid national ID or passport for each founding member
Three proposed corporate names in order of preference
Power of attorney if a formation agent acts on behalf of founders
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is refused, resubmit with alternative names or file a written objection to GAFI's Name Vetting Committee; the committee must resolve within five working days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Notarization of Incorporation Contract and Articles of Association
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Ministry of Justice Notary Public Office (Katib al-'Adl) or GAFI Legalization Unit
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the Incorporation Contract and Articles of Association in Arabic, including the company's name, purpose, registered office, capital and share allocation, management structure, and legal representation terms. All founding members must appear personally before the notary to sign and legalize the documents.
required_dossiers: Name reservation certificate
Draft incorporation contract and articles of association
Founding members' identification documents
Proof of payment of notary and stamp duty fees
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary returns the documents for correction, amend the clauses and re-submit; no additional background check is triggered unless a founder is a foreign sanctioned person, in which case GAFI requests additional source of funds documentation.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Opening Temporary Capital Deposit Bank Account
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed Commercial Bank in Egypt (approved by the Central Bank of Egypt)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open a temporary corporate bank account using the GAFI incorporation file number. Deposit the entire paid-up capital as stated in the Articles of Association. Obtain a capital deposit certificate from the bank to be submitted with the GAFI incorporation application.
required_dossiers: Notarized Incorporation Contract and Articles of Association
GAFI name reservation receipt
Board resolution of founders if the entity has a corporate member
Passport copies of authorized signatories and beneficial owners
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank application is delayed due to enhanced due diligence, provide the bank with a certified declaration of ultimate beneficial owner and evidence of source of funds; escalate to GAFI's facilitation desk for a follow-up letter to the bank.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Submission of Incorporation Application and Commercial Registry Filing
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the complete incorporation application through GAFI's electronic system or the physical one-stop shop. GAFI reviews the legal compliance of the incorporation documents, verifies the capital deposit certificate, and issues the incorporation decision and commercial registration certificate. The company name is then published in the Egyptian Official Gazette.
required_dossiers: Signed and notarized Incorporation Contract and Articles of Association
Bank capital deposit certificate
GAFI standard application form
Lease contract or title deed for the registered office
Valid IDs of founding members and directors
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If GAFI issues a query or rejection, correct the identified deficiencies and resubmit within 15 days; if the rejection is based on contested grounds, file an internal appeal memorandum to the GAFI Chairman, who must issue a decision within 10 working days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-Incorporation Registrations: Tax, Social Insurance, and Import Registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Egyptian Tax Authority (ETA); National Organization for Social Insurance (NOSI); Egyptian Customs Authority
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After issuance of the commercial registration certificate, the company must obtain a tax card from the ETA, register employees and the manager with NOSI for social insurance, and register as an importer with the Customs Authority. For the specialty green coffee bean import activity, an Import Registration Card from GOEIC (General Organization for Export and Import Control) is also required.
required_dossiers: Commercial registration certificate
Articles of Association
Tax card application form and lease contract for the registered office
Certificate of incorporation
Identity documents and social insurance forms of employees
Capital deposit certificate and most recent audited balance sheet if available
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If tax or import registration is delayed, request a provisional number and continue operations with attested copies submitted; any penalty may be waived by paying outstanding dues and filing a written justification with the respective authority.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: General Organization for Export and Import Control (GOEIC) under the Ministry of Trade and Industry; National Food Safety Authority (NFSA) for green coffee bean import clearance
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Import Registration Card (GOEIC) and Commercial Registry Activity Certification for Wholesale Trade

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Registration (Category C) — no full Environmental Impact Assessment report required for dry storage and distribution of green coffee beans; verification of compliance with environmental regulations is required.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Compliance with Law No. 4 of 1994 and its Executive Regulations; wastewater discharge from cleaning operations must meet Decree 92/2013 standards (e.g., BOD ≤ 60 mg/L, COD ≤ 80 mg/L) before discharge to public sewer; no significant VOC emissions are generated; solid waste, including coffee chaff and dust, must be segregated and disposed of through licensed waste handlers.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Civil Defense fire safety certificate for the warehouse and office premises; structural load inspection certificate for storage racks from an accredited engineering office; workplace registration and occupational health clearance from the Ministry of Manpower, including fire extinguishers, emergency exits, and sanitary facilities.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Egyptian Tax Authority (ETA) — official portal: www.eta.gov.eg
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A foreign entity establishing an Egyptian LLC must apply to the Egyptian Tax Authority for a Tax Identification Number (TIN) and VAT registration. The application is filed through the ETA's unified registration system using the company's commercial registration certificate, constitutional documents, power of attorney for the legal representative, and proof of the appointed tax accountant. Upon completion, the ETA issues a Tax Card (identifying the entity for income tax and VAT purposes) and, where applicable, a separate VAT certificate for goods destined for export.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Entity_Level_Taxation; Egyptian LLCs are treated as separate taxable persons subject to corporate income tax on worldwide income if considered resident; export activities are within the territorial scope of Egyptian VAT but may be zero-rated.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No general check-the-box regime exists under Egyptian law. An LLC must file the annual corporate income tax return under the deemed entity-level taxation model. Foreign entities may elect to register for VAT voluntarily even below the mandatory threshold, and may apply for the ETA's advance ruling mechanism with respect to zero-rating of export supplies.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: EGP 500,000 annual taxable turnover of goods and services (mandatory VAT registration threshold; voluntary registration permitted below this level).
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Egypt operates a mandatory e-invoicing system administered by the ETA. VAT-registered entities must integrate with the ETA's real-time invoice clearance platform via approved API connections. Each invoice must be submitted for fiscal clearance before issuance; the ETA validates and returns a digital stamp (QR code / Unique Identifier) which must appear on the final invoice. There is also a phased e-receipt mandate covering business-to-consumer sales. Non-compliance can trigger blocking of invoice clearance and administrative penalties.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Export of physical goods to a destination outside Egypt and services supplied to a non-resident (with services physically performed outside Egypt or otherwise qualifying as exported services under the Egyptian VAT law) are eligible for the 0% VAT rate. The exporter must be the registered VAT payer, retain evidence of the actual export, and ensure payment is received through the banking system in the designated foreign currency.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (proved by the ETA electronic export statement)
Commercial invoice issued under e-invoicing rules
Inward Remittance Certificate (Bank transfer received from abroad)
Certificate of Origin (if required by the importing country)
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: The ETA may retrospectively reverse zero-rated treatment and assess VAT at the standard rate plus late-payment penalties for any export found not to satisfy the documentary and foreign-currency repatriation requirements. Fraudulent zero-rating claims or falsified export documents can result in fines up to 3 times the tax due, imprisonment under tax evasion provisions, and compulsory seizure of assets. The exporter bears the burden of proof for physical export and receipt of foreign currency within 180 days.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Central Bank of Egypt (CBE) and its Foreign Exchange Operations and Compliance Directorate, acting under the Central Bank and Banking System Law No. 194 of 2020 and the Foreign Exchange Law No. 38 of 1994 (as amended).
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The EGP operates under a flexible exchange-rate regime following the March 2024 liberalization supported by the IMF Extended Fund Facility. Current-account transactions (imports of goods, trade-related services, freight, and insurance) are freely convertible for CBE-licensed banks. Capital-account operations are partially convertible: non-resident equity injections and profit/dividend repatriation are permitted but are conditioned on (i) prior registration of the investment with GAFI under Investment Law No. 72 of 2017, (ii) an accredited audit report confirming the distributable profit, and (iii) a valid tax clearance certificate. A single corporate bank account with a licensed bank is the mandated channel; all FX transactions must be reported to the CBE.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: If the LLC undertakes re-exports or earns export proceeds from the distribution of specialty green coffee beyond Egypt, CBE regulations require 100% repatriation of export proceeds to a bank account in Egypt within 4 months from the date of shipment (bill-of-lading date), extendable to 6 months with prior CBE approval. There is no mandatory conversion ratio: the exporter may retain the full foreign currency balance in a USD/EUR account at a licensed Egyptian bank. Late or incomplete repatriation subjects the exporter to administrative fines, suspension of banking facilities, and inclusion on the CBE watchlist.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Capital Escrow Account (for non-resident share capital subscription) and Operational FX Account
Operational Account / Import Settlement Account with Documentary LC desk
Operational Current Account / Trade Finance Facility (LC and CAD)
Operational Account / Multi-currency USD-EUR-EGP account with global correspondent connectivity
Operational Account / Import cover account with back-to-back LCs

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low as a primary treasury rail. Offshore digital EMIs (Wise, Airwallex, Payoneer) do not hold CBE banking licenses and cannot maintain EGP IBANs, execute CBE-reportable FX conversions, or issue Egyptian import purpose codes. They are legally permissible only as ancillary collection vehicles for non-EGP inbound receivables; all settlement for coffee import transactions must be executed through a CBE-licensed bank under Law No. 194 of 2020 to maintain regulatory auditability.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical attendance is mandatory. At least one authorized director or the general manager must appear in person at the selected bank branch to sign the account mandate and undergo the corporate KYC interview. Remote or video onboarding is not recognized by CBE for corporate accounts. A non-resident director may delegate authority through a Power of Attorney notarized and legalized by the Egyptian consulate or apostilled; the attorney-in-fact must still appear physically.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Undisclosed beneficial ownership: nominee shareholders or a non-resident BO holding above 10% without documented source of wealth.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certified Beneficial Ownership Register under Egypt AML Law No. 80 of 2002 (as amended); Egyptian notarized share transfer and constitutional documents; biographical statement and bank reference for each BO above 10%; sworn source-of-wealth declaration supported by 12-month personal bank statements.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Commercial Registration (CR) mismatch: the company object clause does not explicitly cover wholesale coffee trading and import activities.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Updated Commercial Registry extract citing ISIC 4631 / wholesale food and beverage distribution; General Authority for Investment (GAFI) establishment certificate; Chamber of Commerce membership card; and at least two executed green coffee supply agreements evidencing the intended trade.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Wire payments to suppliers domiciled in high-risk or partially compliant jurisdictions (e.g., Ethiopia, Yemen, Kenya) triggering sanctions and negative-news screening.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Full trade file: supplier certificate of incorporation, director list and passbook, signed compliance questionnaire, UN/OFC/CAATSA sanctions self-declaration, certificate of origin, contract and proforma invoice, plus confirmation that funds will only be released against B/L or MT700 LC documents.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Large initial capital injection from a non-resident shareholder with opaque funding trail or recent account creation.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: GAFI Investment Certificate evidencing FDI registration; signed capital declaration form under CBE regulations; foreign bank statements showing the funding trail for at least 6 months; corporate board resolution approving the capital increase; and an undertaking letter confirming lawful sources and tax compliance.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Non-resident shareholders transmit USD/EUR via SWIFT to the LLC's capital escrow account at NBE, Banque Misr, or CIB using the stated purpose 'Share Capital Subscription of Foreign Investment under GAFI Law No. 72 of 2017'. The receiving bank verifies the Commercial Registry extract, Memorandum of Association, GAFI investment certificate, and the CBE statistical purpose code for capital transfers. On receipt, the bank credits the escrowed foreign currency (or converts to EGP at the prevailing interbank rate), issues a Foreign Currency Deposit receipt for audit, and releases funds to the operational account after the CBE's onward reporting is generated.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Supplier payments for specialty green coffee are cleared through two compliant rails: (i) SWIFT MT103 for post-shipment and cash-against-documents settlements, and (ii) Commercial Letter of Credit (MT700) at sight for pre-shipment cover. All import transactions must first be registered on the National Window / Advanced Cargo Information platform (CargoX) to obtain the ACI number, without which the bank will not approve FX disbursement. LCs are issued by the Egyptian bank in USD or the supplier's currency against corporate documentary cover, and disbursements are matched to the presented documents (commercial invoice, B/L, certificate of origin, phytosanitary certificate, and insurance).
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Deliverable USD/EGP FX forward with tenor up to 6 months, executed through a CBE-licensed bank against a verifiable coffee import contract and reported under CBE foreign-exchange operations guidelines
Back-to-back cross-currency swap with the same LC-issuing Egyptian bank, converting the coffee payable into EGP matched to the LLC's operating cash-flow cycle

Trade-backed FX option collar purchased through a CBE-licensed bank for inventory price protection; offshore USD/EGP non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) are not legally permissible for Egyptian resident entities

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within four months after the end of the financial year; an approval-based extension may be available under applicable tax procedures.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-filing penalties generally range from EGP 3,000 to EGP 50,000 under the Unified Tax Procedures Law, subject to statutory conditions. Continued tax noncompliance may prompt assessment and enforcement; it does not itself create an automatic corporate strike-off deadline.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual financial statements and ordinary general meeting
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: General Authority for Investment and Free Zones (GAFI), where filing or notification is required; the company retains the approved statements and meeting minutes.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: The ordinary general meeting is generally held within three months after the financial year-end to consider the accounts and appoint or confirm the auditor.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to prepare accounts, convene the meeting, or comply with applicable GAFI requirements may result in statutory fines or administrative measures. No general automatic strike-off period applies solely for missing the annual meeting.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: An Egyptian LLC is generally required to appoint a registered auditor and have its annual financial statements audited under Companies Law No. 159 of 1981; no general small-company exemption threshold is assumed.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Egyptian Accounting Standards apply to statutory financial statements. Taxable income is determined under Egyptian tax law and may require adjustments to accounting profit.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Maintain current partner and beneficial ownership information and update relevant company, tax, and regulatory records when ownership or control changes. Egypt does not generally impose a separate universal annual UBO confirmation solely to report that no shareholding transfer occurred; verify any applicable GAFI, commercial registry, bank, or sector-specific requirements.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Managers and authorized signatories
General meeting and managers' meeting minutes

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 1,000–4,000 annually for local registered-office and routine corporate-secretarial support; actual arrangements and fees vary.
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 2,000–8,000 annually for a small operating LLC; fee depends on transaction volume, records, and audit scope.
